The Warhawks, led by fourth year head coach [[Keith Richard (basketball)|Keith Richard]], played their home games at [[Fant–Ewing Coliseum]] and were members of the [[Sun Belt Conference]]. They finished the season 10–17, 7–11 in Sun Belt play to finish in seventh place.
